product_overview: QuestionCraft BD is an AI-assisted platform for Bangladeshi teachers to create, manage, and export NCTB-compliant question papers in Bangla and English. It provides authentication, a question bank, a paper builder, live preview, and print-ready PDF export with planned AI generation features.
core_goals: Enable fast, NCTB-aligned question paper creation in Bangla and English
Provide secure user authentication and profile management
Offer robust question bank and editing workflows for teachers
Support print-ready PDF export and paper preview
Integrate AI-powered question generation and review (Phase 2)
Prepare for institutional accounts, subscriptions, and analytics

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register, log in, and verify users via Supabase Auth with email/OTP and optional social login; protect dashboard routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill full name field -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Check Terms checkbox -> Click register button -> See verification prompt -> Redirect to /verify

Navigate to /register -> Fill full name field -> Fill email field with an existing account -> Fill password field (less than 8 chars) -> Click register button -> See validation error message indicating email already in use or password too short
Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password in login form -> Click login button -> See redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email and wrong password in login form -> Click login button -> See error message 'Invalid credentials'
Navigate to /verify -> Fill 6-digit code input -> Click 'যাচাই করুন' button -> See redirect to /dashboard

Navigate to /verify -> Fill incorrect 6-digit code -> Click 'যাচাই করুন' button -> See error message 'Invalid code' -> Click 'কোড পাননি? পুনরায় কোড পাঠান' after timer expires -> See confirmation 'Code sent'

features.name: Question Dashboard
features.description: Main authenticated landing page showing user overview cards, recent activity and quick actions to create papers or manage questions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See welcome message with user name -> View overview cards (total questions, papers, AI stats) -> Click quick action 'নতুন প্রশ্নপত্র তৈরি করুন' -> Navigate to /questions/create
Navigate to /dashboard -> Use sidebar to navigate through sidebar to 'প্রশ্ন ব্যাংক' -> Navigate to /questions
Navigate to /dashboard while not authenticated -> See redirect to /login or access denied message

features.name: Question Creation (Editor)
features.description: Create and edit MCQ, short and broad questions with Bangla support, marks, difficulty and live preview.
user_flows: Navigate to /questions/create -> Select class and subject -> Select question type (MCQ/Short/Broad) -> Input question text in Bengali -> Fill options and mark correct option (for MCQ) -> Set marks and difficulty -> Click Save question -> See confirmation 'Question saved' -> See live preview updated
Navigate to /questions/create -> Select class and subject -> Select question type -> Leave question text empty -> Click Save question -> See validation error 'Question text required'
Navigate to /questions/create -> Input question text in Bengali -> Click 'Add New Question Section' -> Input second question text -> Click Save Draft -> See draft saved notification

features.name: Question Bank Management
features.description: List, search, filter, edit, duplicate and delete user-created questions; add questions from the bank into papers.
user_flows: Navigate to /questions -> Use search bar to enter keywords -> Apply subject and difficulty filters -> See filtered question list
Navigate to /questions -> Click Edit on a question card -> See question open in editor pane -> Make changes -> Click Save -> See 'Updated successfully' message
Navigate to /questions -> Click Delete on a question -> Confirm deletion -> See success toast and question removed from list
Navigate to /questions -> Click Delete on a question -> Confirm deletion -> Network error occurs -> See error message 'Delete failed' and question remains in list

features.name: Paper Builder & Preview
features.description: Assemble question papers by selecting questions from the bank, arranging sections, setting metadata and previewing in A4 layout with NCTB formatting.
user_flows: Navigate to /papers -> Click 'Create new paper' -> Select questions from bank -> Arrange questions using drag-and-drop -> Set metadata (title, subject, time, total marks) -> Click Preview -> Navigate to /preview -> See rendered paper with header, instructions and page numbers
Navigate to /papers -> Click 'Create new paper' -> Add questions but leave title blank -> Click Save or Export -> See validation error 'Title is required' and prevent export

features.name: PDF Export
features.description: Generate and download print-ready PDF exports (NCTB format) from a paper or preview using server-side export endpoints.
user_flows: Navigate to /papers -> Open a saved paper -> Click Download PDF button -> POST to /api/papers/:id/export -> See browser download start with generated PDF
Navigate to /preview -> Click Download PDF button -> POST to /api/papers/:id/export -> PDF generation fails on server -> See error message 'PDF generation failed' and option to retry

features.name: Settings & Profile Management
features.description: Manage user profile, institution, and account settings including password reset and preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> See profile form with full name and institution fields -> Update institution field -> Click Save -> See 'Profile updated' confirmation
Navigate to /settings -> Click change password -> Enter current password and new password -> Click Save -> See success or see error 'Current password incorrect' if validation fails

features.name: AI Question Generation (Phase 2)
features.description: Generate questions via AI by selecting subject, class, topic and difficulty; review and add generated items to the bank or a paper.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click 'AI দিয়ে তৈরি করুন' quick action -> Select subject, class, chapter/topic, question type and number of questions -> Click Generate -> POST to /api/ai/generate-questions -> See generated question list -> Click 'Add to question bank' or 'Add to paper' -> See success notification

Navigate to /dashboard -> Click 'AI দিয়ে তৈরি করুন' quick action -> Fill generation form -> Click Generate -> API returns error or empty result -> See error message 'AI generation failed, please try again' and suggestion to refine inputs
